title: Chappell Roan Surprises Fans with Christina Aguilera
summary:
Fans at Chappell Roan's concert in Los Angeles got a big surprise on Wednesday night, October 21.

About halfway through her show at the Shrine Auditorium, Roan brought out pop star Christina Aguilera as a surprise guest. Roan said Aguilera had "paved the way" for her and other women in pop music to sing and dress however they want. She called Aguilera a "legend."

Aguilera hugged Roan and returned the praise. "From the moment I heard Chappell's voice, I knew she was a force to be reckoned with," she said.

Then Aguilera sang her 2002 hit "Beautiful" while Roan watched. After that, the two singers performed a duet of Roan's song "Coffee," which Aguilera called "one of my favorite songs of hers."

The duet had a funny moment. A nervous Roan mixed up the opening line, and Aguilera laughed kindly. Roan quickly recovered, and the two traded verses before singing together in harmony at the end.

During her set, Roan also performed "Expectations," a song by Olivia Rodrigo. Roan and Rodrigo released a remix of that song just last week. Several other artists performed before Roan took the stage.

The concert was the first of two nights of Roan's event, called the Super Graphic Spectacular. The second night was planned for Thursday, October 22, with Roan headlining again and different opening acts.

All the money raised from the two concerts will go to Roan's Midwest Princess Project. The project has raised more than $800,000 so far for over 60 organizations that support LGBTQ+ communities, including young people.
why_it_matters: The moment shows how pop stars of different generations support each other, and how a concert can raise money for causes the artist cares about.

A remix is a new version of a song made by changing or adding to the original recording.

Verses are the sections of a song that tell the story, usually between the choruses.
